brief: A pomodoro timer with an LED ring that shows the time left

input.message: The catalog has no LED ring, so I can’t build the time-left display you asked for.
input.closest: A USB-powered Pomodoro timer with an OLED countdown, a knob to set and start it, and an optional end chime.
input.closest_brief: Build a USB-powered Pomodoro timer with a 25-minute countdown on an OLED screen, a knob to set and start the timer, and a chime when time is up.
